global_gates.description: Maintainer review of the activation validator commit, this policy and the version-2 decision matrix.

The catalog regenerated at the derived source commit lists all 30 theorems as DIRECT_PROP, research open, depends_on_sorry true, with canonical type hashes recorded in the matrix and equal to the unified frozen inspector's source hashes.
All 60 staged frozen payload inspectors rerun on the candidate toolchain with unchanged type hashes.

The verifier image built from the activation validator passes the production doctor argv as UID 10001 with the noexec work tmpfs, both negative controls report it unready, and every activation bundle control is rejected in it. A release gate: that image is built from the validator commit that pins this tasks release, so this file cannot cite it; ACTIVATION-MANIFEST.json gates activation-image-sandbox and activation-bundle-controls close it. Before the image existed, the 17 full admission controls (3 positive, 14 negative) passed with the candidate binaries in the previous runtime image, which is not the final image.

Dated release-time screens for each activated target: the independent Astra 307-row overlap audit and the version 1 corpus addendum, neither of which matches any of the 30 staged statements; per-target source reviews; fresh primary-source checks for targets 1-6, 10 and 11. These are bounded screens, not a novelty certificate.
Owner approval of activation, of independent rewards and their amounts for the activated targets, and of the target 12 exclusion and the held Frankl group.
Maintainer review of the research-targets source family: status source, selection-audit evidence format, and package-authored attribution on public pages.

The derived Lean 4.35.0-rc2 / Mathlib 065356127b1d source with Math15 and Math30 builds with zero errors in the candidate (full source, trusted tools, the --wfail research libraries and the catalog), and every kernel-safe support declaration uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

reward_groups.rationale: Targets 7-9 share a hypothetical minimal-counterexample antecedent; the proper-cover and full-cover branches need not be disjoint, so one sufficiently strong theorem could discharge several targets. This does not show the three statements are equivalent. Hold all three until an explicit correlated-payout decision is recorded.

target_gates.description: A compliant certificate or proof route is demonstrated at full size and its verifier time and memory are measured within the published task limits. An impractical certificate format or an unmeasured computed certificate does not satisfy this.
Cite the published justification for the extra hypothesis in the statement (the known four-speed 1/5 lower bound) in the source docstring.
An explicit decision on correlated rewards for the shared-antecedent group.
Document in the source that primitivity repairs a scaling problem in the literal source question.
Review of the public conditional cycle-exclusion claim and its hypotheses against the exact target.
Resource and proof-route benchmark showing a compliant proof is feasible within verifier limits; large known certificate routes justify benchmarks, not impossibility claims.
Correct the catalog literature baseline (the unconditional m <= 3e result) and recheck the target.
Release-time refresh of rapidly changing lower-bound literature.
Independent source novelty check for the exact statement.
Independent source novelty check for the exact statement. (targets 10, 11)
Label the statement as a package-authored proposed answer for a narrower regime, not the source's verbatim conjecture.
Visually verify the exact survey cell (DS1.18 Table IXa, printed page 36) that the statement relies on.

Full-admission performance and confidence policy for witness-scale submissions: representative witness-shaped tests through the full pipeline under the pinned static policy and verifier limits. The relaxed 22/27/37-vertex certificate benchmark passed but is not a sharp witness. This gate does not require a solution of the open statement before listing.

targets.review_disposition: Collatz cycle bound: accepted; novelty/hypothesis and resource hold. A public unrefereed repository claims to exclude cycles with at most 101 local minima assuming convergence through 2^71 and RhinBound; this is not an unconditional Lean proof of the exact target and was not independently built. Claims that the target is unprovable or already solved are not established.
targets.title: Collatz exclusion of 96-local-minimum cycles

targets.review_disposition: Collatz range below 2^72: checker sound; the supplied certificate format has 2^72-2 rows and no feasible full certificate or compliant alternative was demonstrated; hold. Not a proof that every compressed or conceptual proof is impossible.
targets.title: Collatz convergence below 2^72
